propositions: macOS pytest suite exhibits 20-21s wall time with 13-14s system CPU spent on Git operations, creating thousands of temporary repositories in slow storage below pytest --basetemp
Measured local full-suite runs retain ~2.1 GiB across default and integration tiers sequentially, requiring sized RAM disk allocation with headroom while respecting runner memory limits

APFS RAM disk creation must be macOS-only, measured with bounded sizing, sequentially cleared between test phases, and always-detached including failure paths without affecting test selection, worker counts, timeouts, or coverage
Initial implementation attempts showed no performance gain and introduced cleanup contract defects when snapshot fixtures deliberately leave read-only trees, requiring repair or reversion
